crop.notes: Includes the Lexington Live-Bird Shoot and 'A Bear Walks Into Town' items; the Allen part is the 'Sporting Notes' paragraph in the middle.

title.suggested: Tom Allen's Market Street concert notice; Edward Smith to visit

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a card for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street with free concerts nightly, adding that Edward Smith would be his guest.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, April 5, 1890, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen advertised as 'retired champion pugilist of the world' at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with a free concert every evening
Edward Smith was to be Allen's guest for a few days

notes: The title 'Announces Retirement From Prize Ring' is wrong; this is a standing notice. The same page has an 'Ed Smith as a Fighter' item (Denver pugilist), probably the same Edward Smith, but that is outside the clipping.
